name: state
description: Select objects by the state indicators of the zone constitutive model. The s is matched to any state name returned by the constitutive model. Zones reporting that state will be selected by the element.In 3DEC blocks will be selected if they contain a zone that is selected.

sub_keywords.name: any
sub_keywords.description: The zone is considered to have that state if any of its internal tetrahedra have that state.

sub_keywords.name: average
sub_keywords.description: The zone is considered to have that state only if at least 50% of the tetrahedra (by volume) have that state. This is the default.

official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 shared kernel manual: Range Phrase Keyword Reference
